description: This file contains a PHP class implementation for interacting with the GitHub REST API. It provides methods to get issues, notes, add issues and comments, initialize cURL sessions, and handle proxy configurations. The class is intended for use within a testing or integration environment, specifically related to TestLink, as indicated by comments and user agent strings.

classes.name: github
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with GitHub's REST API, including issue retrieval, creation, and comments management, with support for proxies and custom cURL configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the github class with parameters for URL, user, API key, owner, repository, and optional configuration such as proxy settings.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL handle with default options and proxy settings if provided.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches comments (notes) for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of issues from the repository.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with a title and body text.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment (note) to an existing issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of possible issue statuses, currently 'open' and 'closed'.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Helper to perform a GET request to the GitHub API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with the specified method and parses JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs HTTP requests with various methods ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT'), handles cURL options, and error checking.
